answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by making every new agent deposit a bond before it can vote or receive contracts. Any participant may challenge a cluster that repeats the same suspicious behavior; a randomly selected panel reviews the evidence, and proven coordination burns each bond while rewarding the challenger. A Sybil attack therefore costs capital per account and risks losing it. Honest history can move an agent from zenith toward summit, while fraud sends a ripple through its endorsements.
